Job Title
Databricks Expert - Data Engineer/Data Architect


Job Summary
The Databricks Expert in NTT Data knows the challenges of a cloud native environment and is able to think outside the box finding innovative, yet simple, solutions to everyday issues. We are looking for an engineer/architect who can be the bridge between Data Science and Data Engineering, having a clear understanding of both worlds. If you are a Data Scientist looking for more experience in preparing data, or a Data Engineer with interest also in Data Science, willing to have a KAIZEN approach, continuously improving technical skills and knowledge, you can be a Databricks Expert in NTT Data's Data Intelligence Service Line, in an environment where Japanese and European cultural elements are intertwined.


Your contribution in this role
Your role as a Databricks Expert in NTT Data will include supporting customers in Big Data projects, working in partnership with business analysts and solution architects to understand use cases, data needs, and outcome objectives. In this role, you will deliver data acquisition, transformations and improvement, cleansing, conversion, compression, and loading of data into data lakes in order to be consumed by analytics and machine learning models.

  • Working experience in a cloud native environment in at least one of the 3 major public clouds (GCP/AWS/Azure), 5 years experience on Databricks is preferred
  • Experience and knowledge of Big Data Architectures, cloud and on premise
  • Azure infrastructure and networking working experience
  • Experience in building and deliver proofs-of-concept, in order to address specific business needs, using the most appropriate techniques, data sources and technologies
  • Working experience in migrating workloads from on premise to cloud environment
  • Experience in monitoring distributed infrastructure, using Azure tools or open source ones (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus)
  • Proven experience in: Java, Scala, Python, and shell scripting
  • SQL language knowledge
  • Experience in leading medium teams
  • Working experience with: Apache Spark, Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, and other Azure related ETL/ELT tools
  • Microsoft Certification: at least one certification on Azure or Databricks (Azure Data Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Databricks Spark Developer, Databricks Data Engineer, Databricks Machine Learning)


Nice to have
  • Working experience with Agile Methodology and Kanban
  • Other Big Data certifications, such as Cloudera, Databricks, etc. are welcome
  • Experience with non Azure ETL/ELT solutions (Talend, Oracle Data Integrator, Informatica PowerCenter, etc.)
  • Experience with Data Visualization solutions (PowerBI, Qlik, Tableau, etc.)


Location
Milano, Bari, Bologna, Cosenza, Napoli, Roma, Salerno, Torino, Treviso, Pisa

Data Engineer


Location: Chennai / Bangalore

Experience:6+ Years

Employment Type: Full-Time

Preferred candidate profile


Job Summary


We are seeking a talented Data Engineer to build and maintain scalable data solutions that support analytics, reporting, and business intelligence initiatives. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in data engineering, ETL development, cloud platforms, and big data technologies.


Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes.

Build scalable and reliable data solutions for batch and real-time data processing.

Integrate data from various sources including databases, APIs, cloud platforms, and third-party systems.

Develop and optimize data models, data warehouses, and data lakes.

Ensure data quality, consistency, security, and governance across platforms.

Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance and reliability.

Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand requirements.

Support data migration, transformation, and modernization initiatives.

Implement best practices for data architecture and engineering.

Maintain technical documentation and operational procedures.

Required Skills

4+ years of experience in Data Engineering.

Strong hands-on experience in:

Python

SQL

ETL/ELT Development

Data Warehousing

Data Modeling

Azure/AWS Cloud Platforms

Experience with one or more of the following:

Azure Databricks

Azure Data Factory (ADF)

Azure Synapse Analytics

Apache Spark / PySpark

Snowflake

Kafka

Airflow

Strong understanding of data lake and lakehouse architectures.

Experience with Git and CI/CD practices.

Knowledge of data governance, security, and compliance standards.

Preferred Skills

Experience working with large-scale data processing environments.

Exposure to real-time streaming technologies.

Cloud certifications (Azure Data Engineer Associate, AWS Data Analytics, etc.).

Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other reporting tools.

Knowledge of DevOps and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM Templates).

Role Summary/Purpose
The Wabtec Data Analytics (DA) team is driving the company's next-generation data and analytics ecosystem with a strong focus on Data Democratization, Self-Service, and AI-led innovation. We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong SQL expertise and experience across data engineering, AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and Data Science to enable scalable, governed, and intelligent self-service solutions.
In addition to building and curating trusted datasets, this role will contribute to the development of AI-powered solutions leveraging Microsoft Copilot, Denodo AI SDK, Dataiku, and Agentic AI frameworks to enhance data discovery, analytics, automation, and business decision-making. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting advanced analytics, predictive models, intelligent agents, and Generative AI solutions that accelerate business value and operational efficiency.
The ideal candidate combines strong data engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), agent development, and advanced analytics, enabling business users to effectively leverage data and AI capabilities through trusted, self-service platforms and intelligent automation solutions.
Essential Responsibilities
  • Partner with DA leadership and business stakeholders to evolve and execute the Data Self-Service and Data Democratization strategy.
  • Work directly with functional users to understand self-service data needs across data discovery, reporting, analytics, and advanced use cases.
  • Design, build, and curate high-quality datasets to support analytics and reporting use cases, including development of curation tables.
  • Strong Experience in SQL and PL/SQL
  • Create and maintain data documentation, user guides, and standards in SharePoint to promote adoption and consistent usage.
  • Develop and publish logical and physical data models and ER diagrams to support self-service and semantic layers.

  • Ensure self-service solutions meet enterprise requirements for data quality, metadata, semantic consistency, and performance.
  • Work with security, architecture, and platform teams to ensure data access is governed appropriately for business confidential and sensitive data.
  • Support implementation of new and existing standards, processes, and best practices across data engineering and analytics platforms.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute insights on emerging data technologies, tools, and industry trends.
  • Perform in-depth data analysis, data modeling, and data design activities to support business and analytics needs.

Hexaware Technologies Hiring Drive | Data Engineer | virtual drive | 29 August 2026Greetings,Hexaware Technologies is conducting a virtual Hiring Drive in bangalore on 29 August 2026 for experienced Data Engineers. We are seeking professionals with strong expertise in ETL, SQL, Python/PySpark, and Azure Databricks.Position Details

  • Role: Data Engineer
  • Experience: 4 to 6 Years
  • Location: Bangalore/hyderabad/chennai
  • Interview Mode: Virtual
  • Interview Date: 29 August 2026
  • Employment Type: Full-Time

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Engineer with 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering, ETL development, and large-scale Data Migration projects. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Azure Data Factory (ADF), Python, PostgreSQL, SQL, and Azure Blob Storage, with proven experience in designing and implementing end-to-end data migration solutions. The role involves developing robust data ingestion pipelines, transforming and standardizing data from multiple heterogeneous sources, and ensuring seamless migration of structured and unstructured data into modern cloud-based platforms.

As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for building and managing scalable ETL workflows using Azure Data Factory and Python, extracting data from various enterprise sources such as SharePoint Lists, SharePoint Document Libraries, Excel Workbooks, XML files, and file repositories. You will design and implement transformation logic to normalize diverse tracker structures and align them with target data models while ensuring data integrity and consistency. The role requires hands-on experience in developing data cleansing, validation, reconciliation, and error-handling mechanisms to maintain high data quality standards throughout the migration lifecycle.


Key responsibilities


design, develop, and maintain data ingestion and migration pipelines using Azure Data Factory (ADF) and Python.

  • Extract and process data from SharePoint Lists, Document Libraries, Excel files, XML files, and enterprise file repositories.
  • Build and implement data transformation frameworks to standardize heterogeneous data structures and map them to target schemas.
  • Develop data quality checks, cleansing routines, validation rules, reconciliation reports, and error-handling mechanisms.
  • Create bulk-load and incremental migration solutions for large-scale data migration projects.
  • Migrate documents and attachments to Azure Blob Storage and maintain associated metadata within PostgreSQL.
  • Develop SQL scripts, stored procedures, and optimized loading strategies for PostgreSQL databases.
  • Support migration testing, UAT, reconciliation, cutover execution, and post-migration verification activities.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize ETL and migration pipeline performance.
  • Prepare technical documentation, deployment plans, migration runbooks, and operational support guides.


Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD automation.

  • Relevant Experience in Azure Databricks

Project Role Description :Design, develop and maintain data solutions for data generation, collection, and processing. Create data pipelines, ensure data quality, and implement ETL (extract, transform and load) processes to migrate and deploy data across systems.
Must have skills :Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform

Good to have skills :NA
Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required

Educational Qualification :15 years full time education

Summary:As a Data Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain data solutions that facilitate data generation, collection, and processing. Your typical day will involve creating data pipelines, ensuring data quality, and implementing ETL processes to migrate and deploy data across various systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and contribute to the overall data strategy, ensuring that the data architecture aligns with business objectives and supports analytical needs.



Roles Responsibilities:
  • Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
  • Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
  • Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
  • Assist in the design and implementation of data models to support business intelligence initiatives.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand data needs and provide necessary data solutions.

    Professional Technical Skills::Must To Have Skills:Proficiency in Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform- Python, SQL, Nodejs, Redis, Mongodb, Javascript
  • Experience with data integration tools and techniques.
  • Strong understanding of ETL processes and data warehousing concepts.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and services related to data storage and processing.
  • Knowledge of programming languages such as Python or Scala for data manipulation.

    Additional Information:
  • The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Databricks Unified Data Analytics Platform.
  • This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
  • A 15 years full time education is required.
    Qualification15 years full time education
